applying and calibrating the delta log R (Passey) resistivity–sonic overlay method
selecting organic-lean baselines for delta log R overlays
understanding why delta log R underestimates TOC at high thermal maturity
not_good_for: core-based geochemistry workflows (Rock-Eval pyrolysis, LECO TOC procedures)
reservoir engineering, completion design, or production forecasting
stratigraphy, depositional setting, or regional correlation of the Eagle Ford
mineralogy, brittleness, or geomechanical property estimation
porosity, saturation, or permeability petrophysics
applying the calibrations directly to other shale plays without local rework
card.scope: Trade-press (Oil & Gas Journal) study, Eagle Ford Shale of South Texas; log-based organic-richness estimation only. Baselines and density–TOC coefficients are locally calibrated and maturity-dependent, so numbers should be re-derived for other basins or even other Eagle Ford maturity windows. Not a peer-reviewed source; check the publication date before using it as current practice.

card.covers: A single practical how-to entry on the minimum curvature method for directional survey calculation, giving the ratio-factor and dogleg-angle formulas, a worked two-station example, and a caution about a commonly circulated incorrect dogleg equation.
authoritative_for: minimum curvature formulas for converting measured depth to TVD, northing, and easting
ratio factor (RF) computation from the dogleg angle
dogleg angle between two survey stations from inclination and azimuth pairs
a worked numeric example of TVD between two survey stations
identifying a widely reproduced erroneous dogleg equation
not_good_for: other survey calculation methods (radius of curvature, balanced tangential, average angle, tangential)
survey tool physics, gyro/MWD instrument error models, or survey uncertainty ellipses
wellbore anticollision, torque and drag, or well planning workflows
dogleg severity limits, BHA design, or steering decisions
any geologic, stratigraphic, basin, or formation-specific content
card.scope: Drilling-engineering calculation note, not a geoscience source; generic and basin-independent, but a brief single-topic web article rather than a standards document (e.g., no ISCWSA error-model treatment) — verify units and sign conventions against your own survey software before production use.
